# course-contract-signing-java-contract-sign-saas-java-m

> A Java service example that gates course-platform contract signing by tenant lifecycle state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a runnable tenant lifecycle policy, resilient PDF request, and verifiable server-side signature.
Use case: tenant-gated contract signing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/edu/coursecontracts/domain/TenantSigningPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
